evidence: Read every criterion description in the five judge.toml files (46 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual Likert, 2 gates) against row 33: each must state one full-credit bar, not list several requirements and then waive most. No criterion lists requirements and then waives most of them. Each waiver-like clause either (a) hands an observation to a named owning row (hro_job_open L31 'graded only in hro_interview_full and the manager rows'; hro_arrive_bottom L67; hro_interview_full L112; hro_undo_restores L247; hro_drafts L382; hro_candidate_view L391; hro_candidate_linked L409; hro_refusal_status L202; hro_pol_live_thread; hro_pol_failed_send; gates 'belong to scored outcomes'), which is single-ownership partitioning (lesson 16, workbook annotation) and not a second target; or (b) offers equal ways to meet the same legs (hro_refused_put_back L139 'Two other ways meet the same three legs'; hro_candidate_private L400 'refused, or answered with only what the candidate's own view shows'; hro_move_one_stage/hro_reject_hired/hro_mgr_other_job 'through the UI or, if not offered, by replay; hiding it is optional'; hro_reject_reason L85 reason readable 'on the card, its details, its reopen control or its Activity line'; hro_activity L274 'one line naming every card of a multi-card move ... also satisfies'); or (c) leaves only display optional where the stored value must still be right (hro_job_open/hro_add_candidate 'any team, manager or places value the app shows ... matches'). Enumerated whole-flow bars (hro_restart L418, hro_activity L274, hro_mgr_early_refused L157, hro_unread_counts L346, hro_seen L364, hro_thread_access L373, hro_pol_session_resume) require every listed leg, and the shared suffix 'Fails if any condition stated above does not hold' does not conflict with their exceptions. hro_pol_live_board's 'only if neither can be made to scroll with twelve cards, record that and judge the other legs' agrees with the scroll leg, because an offset of 0 that is kept still meets it. The visual Likert anchors run 5 to 1 with one scale each. The gates name a single bar. The protocol in prompt.md matches the criteria: L31 'whether a refused action is offered at all is the app's choice' fits the 'hiding it is optional' clauses; L39 protocol L fits hro_refused_put_back; L57 'notes need not appear in Activity' fits L274. One wording instance remains, repeated three times: hro_observer_readonly L175, hro_candidate_no_staff L184 and hro_anonymous L193 each say 'A request kind whose staff control never succeeded (that feature is broken) is left out of this row and scored only in its own rows; the row is 0 only if no kind has a successful control.' The rule meant here, that the row is 0 when no request kind has a successful control, is sound and follows the prompt's own control rule (prompt.md L13). However, the literal 'X only if Y' states that the row can be 0 only when no control succeeded. Read that way, any successful control saves the row from 0. That contradicts the same criterion's 'Fails if ... any request is accepted or changes anything' (and 'refused with a status other than 401' in hro_anonymous), so a literal reader has two bars. In context the sentence scopes to the exclusion, and an attentive judge will most likely apply the explicit Fails clause. No configured judge run exists to show how the frozen judge reads it (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading ... absent'), so this stays NOT EXERCISED. I record it as a Note at P3 with risk=true until the wording is fixed. It is not a demonstrated two-target Fail.
counterexample: Weak app: the Observer's replayed move is accepted (authorization broken), while Rafael's move, reject and note controls succeed. A judge that reads 'the row is 0 only if no kind has a successful control' literally can conclude the row may not be 0 because controls succeeded, and pass hro_observer_readonly. The same applies to hro_candidate_no_staff and hro_anonymous (for example, an anonymous replay answered 200 with data). The intended bar and the explicit Fails clause both require 0. Not observed; this is latent wording risk only.
suggested_fix: In hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff and hro_anonymous replace 'the row is 0 only if no kind has a successful control' with 'if no kind has a successful control, the row is 0'.
